pitch:
Kiddo "Ready for First Grade": in 10 minutes a day your child aged 4-6 practises letters and numbers in Uzbek, Russian or English, with a real recorded voice and a mascot.
Every week you get a report in the parent area showing which letters and numbers your child now knows; you set the daily time limit yourself; no ads; it works offline after one download on Wi-Fi.
Free: letters and numbers in one language. PRO adds the full first-grade path in all three languages, the weekly report, and homework you set.
Try PRO free for 14 days, no card needed. Then 24,990 so'm a month or 238,990 so'm a year, paid with Payme or Click (no foreign card needed). Money back within 14 days of your first payment if you are not happy.
Get it on Google Play, the App Store, or the web.
